title: Countably n-rectifiable sets of finite measure have density one almost everywhere (general fact G7; Simon Ch. 3, 1.2, 1.3, 1.5(3), 1.6)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set that is countably n-rectifiable with H^n(M) < ∞ (H^n = μHE[n]). Then H^n(M ∩ B_t(w))/(ω_n t^n) → 1 in [0, ∞] as t ↓ 0 for H^n-almost every w ∈ M (ω_n = unitBallVolume n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ n → MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → ∀ᵐ w ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => μHE[n] (M ∩ ball w t) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
